📋 PlagPro provides comprehensive plagiarism reports including:

✅ Overall similarity percentage score
✅ Highlighted matched text sections
✅ Source citations with links
✅ Page-by-page breakdown
✅ Grammar & style suggestions (Student+ plans)

📥 Export Options:
• PDF export (Student plan and above)
• Word/DOCX export (Student plan and above)
• White-label reports (Professional plan)

Reports are available instantly after analysis. Upgrade to Student or Professional for full detailed reports.
